sections.text: Inspection and repair of all Parts

items:
Check the valves cone (3) and regrind the 
 sealing surface of it if needed.

Check the valves seat (17) and regrind it if 
 needed.

Repair the valve cone (3) and valve seat (17) 
 in a specialist workshop if grinding can not repair the wear in there. ( in 
 weld type the valve end must be cut from the pipe line , in flange type it is 
 easy which flange bolts screwed off only)

Check the Spindle (2) and repair it if needed 
 or replace it.

Check the Gland follower (9) and repair it if 
 needed or replace it.
Clean every connection face.
Change gasket (16).

Check the body (1) from any cracks or wear by 
 using penetration fluids and repair it if found by using suitable filler 
 material or its equivalent acc. to table (1).

Check the coupling (12) between drive unit 
 shaft and valve spindle and repair it if needed.

Change gasket for flange end in case of flange 
 type.

sections.text: Clean every part well before any assembly.

Assembly the valve parts in reverse sequence of 
 disassembly.

items:
Assembly the valve parts in reverse sequence of 
 disassembly.
Readjust the limit &moment switches.

sections.text: Replace the Packing of Valve Gland

items:
Clean the stuffing box chamber and the cover 
 well.
Lubricate the gland bolts and nuts.
Use suitable size of packing.

Wire the suitable packing size on a part of 
 shaft with the same diameter of valve spindle.

Cut all packing rings along the shaft by using 
 sharp knife.

Fit the rings in the stuffing box chamber with 
 the cut turned 180, starting at 9 clock.
Tighten the gland bolts.

Open and close the valve and be sure that the 
 valve operation is correct.

If you need any help please go to the 
 operating instruction for repairs and maintenance D-4.

Put the valve into operation and check the 
 list of checking before isolated.

Introduction
This document out outlines 
 the minor maintenance procedure as indicated by P1 in the above title 
 block for the manual 
 gate valve depending on external / internal leakage
This valve to be used in case of using two positions, open or 
 closed completely.
The first 
 draft initiated and tested by eng. Fawzy Ahmed Basuoni at 27 Dec 2003, 
 accepted by General Director eng. Saad Mostafa, revised by EDEPC eng. Samir 
 Abdel-Gelil, and approved by eng. Awad Mohammed Fathy Soliman Head 
 Sector of Talkha power station.

 Specification

Safety Precautions
Work order

Work to be Carried Out
Before Isolating the Valve 
Mechanically
Check any leakage from valve gland. If it 
 found, retighten on gland bolts.
Check any leakage from gasket between yoke 
 cover and valve body. If it found retighten the bolts.
Check any internal leakage.
Check any leakage from the valve bodies

After Isolating the Valve 
Mechanically
Be sure the valve was out of operation and the 
 pressure inside the pipeline connected to the valve must be zero from the two 
 end of the valve.
Be sure the pipeline is drained.
Be sure the pipeline is drained.
Disassembly the 
Valve
Screw off nut (10) of bolt (11), which 
 connected drive unit (14) with yoke seat (13).
Lift up drive unit (14) by using suitable 
 lifting device.
Screw off nut (5) of bolt (6), which connected 
 yoke (4) with valve body (1).
Take out con (3) from spindle (2).
Screw off nut (7) of gland bolts (8).
Withdraw spindle (2) from yoke (4) & gland 
 chamber.
Take out the gland follower (9).
Take out gland packing (15) from gland 
 chamber.
Screw off nut of bolts for flange end in case 
 of flange type.
Inspection and repair of all Parts
Check the valves cone (3) and regrind the 
 sealing surface of it if needed.
Check the valves seat (17) and regrind it if 
 needed.
Repair the valve cone (3) and valve seat (17) 
 in a specialist workshop if grinding can not repair the wear in there. ( in 
 weld type the valve end must be cut from the pipe line , in flange type it is 
 easy which flange bolts screwed off only)
Check the Spindle (2) and repair it if needed 
 or replace it.
Check the Gland follower (9) and repair it if 
 needed or replace it.
Clean every connection face.
Change gasket (16).
Check the body (1) from any cracks or wear by 
 using penetration fluids and repair it if found by using suitable filler 
 material or its equivalent acc. to table (1).
Check the coupling (12) between drive unit 
 shaft and valve spindle and repair it if needed.
Change gasket for flange end in case of flange 
 type.
Assembly of Valve
Clean every part well before any assembly.
Assembly the valve parts in reverse sequence of 
 disassembly.
Readjust the limit &moment switches.
Assembly the valve parts in reverse sequence of 
 disassembly.
Readjust the limit &moment switches.
Replace the Packing of Valve Gland
Clean the stuffing box chamber and the cover 
 well.
Lubricate the gland bolts and nuts.
Use suitable size of packing.
Wire the suitable packing size on a part of 
 shaft with the same diameter of valve spindle.
Cut all packing rings along the shaft by using 
 sharp knife.
Fit the rings in the stuffing box chamber with 
 the cut turned 180, starting at 9 clock.
Tighten the gland bolts.
Open and close the valve and be sure that the 
 valve operation is correct.
If you need any help please go to the 
 operating instruction for repairs and maintenance D-4.
Put the valve into operation and check the 
 list of checking before isolated.
